title: 분홍빛 다리
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop City Pop. Clean electric guitar plays syncopated funk-style muted strums and arpeggiated chords. A synth bass performs a melodic, walking line with a rounded, analog tone. Drums feature a crisp snare and a steady eighth-note hi-hat pattern. A bright, polyphonic synth pad provides sustained harmonic support. Female vocals are delivered in a breathy, melodic style with light doubling in the chorus. The arrangement includes a subtle electric piano playing jazz-influenced extensions. Key of G Major. Tempo 105 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar muted strums, synth bass walking line, steady drums]

[Verse 1]
[breathy female vocals]
다리 위에 서 있어
바람이 강을 건너
네 머리카락 날려
새벽이 분홍이야
이어폰 한쪽 나 [bass slides]
한쪽 나
이 노래 아는 거지 고개 끄덕여
박자가 맞아

[Chorus]
[synth pads swell, fuller vocal layering]
분홍빛 다리 위야
시간아 멈춰줘
이 새벽만 남겨 너와 나
